service_cards.title: Burglar Alarms
service_cards.description: Burglar Alarms provide one of the best deterrents against a break in and an effective response in the event of one. We can design your burglar alarm system to suit your needs. We offer both wired and wireless systems with the latest app controlled technology.

service_cards.title: CCTV Systems
service_cards.description: CCTV camera systems are becoming popular due to their efficiency and effectiveness in providing security and reassurance for all types of premises. All of our systems can be set up for remote viewing via a smartphone, tablet or computer.

service_cards.title: Access Control
service_cards.description: Access control and door entry systems... Allow freedom of movement for authorised personnel to certain and designated areas of a premises as well as restrictive access to sensitive areas and general access of a building for complete peace of mind.
